title: Family Castle Survivor Game
author: HallucinatedGames
selftext:
My kids really like Deep Rock Galactic Survivor, and like fantasy knights and battles. They love to “make” their own games with me and AI so they can make the game work however they want. I have found that taking pictures of them in a T Pose and then using OpenAI to create them into realistic photos in knight armor, wizard robes, etc I can use that to create models of them and put them in the game. I am using ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, Trellis 2.0 all to build the assets locally on my gaming PC. The manual part I still do is rigging the models for animations, which I’m using https://mesh2motion.org to do.

The graphics quality struggles, and the map layouts it auto builds are clunky, but it’s good enough for family game night. They love being able to tweak the game however they want with their imaginations and see their models in the game. No matter how ridiculous their ask it will attempt to add it which is part of the fun!
